name: Prudence
overview: Scripture reveals prudence as careful and strategic planning in the face of potential danger, exemplified by Jacob's conduct toward Esau. Jacob sent messengers ahead to inform Esau of his presence and possessions, seeking favor and preparing for possible conflict. When informed that Esau was approaching with four hundred men, Jacob prudently divided his people and livestock into two groups to mitigate total loss if attacked. These actions demonstrate a wise and cautious approach grounded in trust in God while exercising practical foresight.
